values.meaning: bonus physical damage on empowered basic attack (percent of AD)
additional bonus physical damage on empowered attack vs monsters

values.quote: generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Charge'' for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts
values.binNote: no bin DataValue carries the 6 second Charge duration

mechanics.claim: Ability casts grant a stack of Charge that basic attacks consume for bonus damage; attacks are empowered by consuming a stack, not applied automatically as an on-hit effect.
mechanics.quote: '''Riven's''' {{tip|basic attacks}}<!--not on-hit--> are empowered to each consume a stack to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}

mechanics.claim: Consuming a stack refreshes the Charge duration, and casting an ability also refreshes existing stacks' duration.
mechanics.quote: Runic Blade's duration also refreshes when Riven consumes a stack.

mechanics.claim: The bonus damage is affected by critical strike modifiers and applies life steal at 100% effectiveness.
mechanics.quote: The '''bonus''' damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers and {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.

mechanics.claim: Damage against structures is reduced by 50%.
mechanics.quote: reduced to{{ft|50%|{{as|{{pp|key=%|(30 + (45-30)/17*(x-1))*0.5 for 20|formula=50% of non-structure damage}} AD}}}}against {{tip|structures}}

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack does not trigger against wards.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|wards}}.
